name: ego-browser
summary: SKILL.md that teaches coding agents to drive the ego-lite Chromium browser: navigation, clicks, forms, screenshots and CDP.
description: Skill file from the ego-lite repo (v2.0.0) that documents the browser API agents call: TaskSpace and Page helpers for navigation, semantic snapshots and selectors, screenshots, mouse and keyboard input, form filling, file uploads, dialogs and CDP escape hatches, plus round-based workflow rules for reusing pages and handing control back to the user.
contains: SKILL.md v2.0.0 (2026-09-09) for the ego-browser API
TaskSpace API: spaces, pages, tabs, adopt/release, waitForControl, handOff, finish
Page API: goto, snapshot, screenshot, click, fill, selectOption, waits, mouse, keyboard, evaluate, cdp
guidance on semantic selectors vs visual coordinates, action receipts, popups and dialogs
